notes.subject: מחלל
notes.rationale: חלל i min 'bore/holim hole' — mi tok 'holim pen, i pen gut', i no wok long wanpela tok tasol.

notes.subject: מוסר שלומנו
notes.rationale: 'skelim pasin bilong pes bilong yumi' — ol tanim tok i tok 'chastisement of our peace'; tok tru em i pasin bilong skelim i bringim pes.

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i nidim predicate marker 'i' na copula, Hibru i no gat.

translation: Na em i holim pen long ⟨את⟩ — na ⟨i⟩ pen bilong ol paspas bilong yumi, ⟨i⟩ bruk bilong ol rong bilong yumi; skelim pasin bilong pes bilong yumi i stap antap long em, na long ol mark bilong pen long bodi bilong em, yumi ⟨i⟩ kamap gut gen.

tokens.gloss: i holim pen, i pen gut
na long ol mark bilong pen bilong em
